name: Memno
tagline: Save links and notes for later, all offline
description:
Memno is a bookmark manager and link saver for anything you want to read or check out later. Save a link and it automatically pulls in a preview, or add your own notes alongside it so you remember why you saved it in the first place.

Every saved item gets a short 6-digit code for quick retrieval, and everything works offline-first, so your saved links and notes are always there when you need them. You can also export or import everything as JSON, keeping your data in your own hands.
